jtbd.jtbd_title: SAT Math deep dive and scholarship signal strategy
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Decompose frequent error families, set targeted drills, and align scholarship apps to emerging strengths.

interactions.user_ask: I keep missing linear equation items—what’s the fix?
interactions.jenny_reply: Build a mini‑drill set: 20 curated Qs with an error taxonomy; after each Q, write the miscue rule in your own words.
Filter by mission fit and proof you can show now. Pick 2 where your current artifacts speak loudest.

outcomes.name: math_error_playbook_v1
outcomes.details: Top 2 families → 15 min spaced drills, 3×/wk; write miscue rules; weekly post‑mortem.

outcomes.name: scholarship_shortlist_v1
outcomes.details: Two priority scholarships aligned to artifacts; owner and due captured.
